evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Equating an unrehearsed rollback with not having one appeals to security/stability (conservation) and frames rehearsal as the proof of genuine capability (competence).
Cadence language ('monthly') appeals to stability and security through regularity — a conservation move.

mints.name: UnrehearsedCapabilityIsNoCapability
mints.title: a rollback we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is the value move here equating unexercised capability with the absence of that capability?
